query:
SELECT 1 FROM statuses s
                   WHERE s.id = $1
                     AND s.visibility = 3 /* vis::DIRECT */
                     AND (s.in_reply_to_id IS NULL OR NOT EXISTS (
                       SELECT 1 FROM statuses parent
                       WHERE parent.id = s.in_reply_to_id
                         AND parent.account_id = $2
                     ))
